text_block_list.text: One day, during training camp...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have a minute?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nothing, just... Can I borrow you for a
second?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Okay, no one is around...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's not a big deal, but about our
training...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Tell it to me straight. What do you think
is
lacking in my performance?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Don't say "everything," though. That'd
just make
me sad.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I want to do some extra training, but
first, I need
your expert opinion. So lay
it on me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
See, I'm behind all the others when it
comes to
training and race experience.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But... I'm competing with Teio here, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I know it's going to be super, super hard going up against her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So I want to be as ready as I can be.

Although still anxious about her
prospects, it's
clear Nice Nature is
motivated. If that's the case,
what I can
say to her is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh... And what exactly do you mean?

I suggest that she train on the sand to
strengthen
her core, which can lead to
more stability during
races.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's true. A strong core is important.
Okay, I'll
do it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right, then I'm off to train. See ya
la—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What? Why? You just gave me advice
for it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait... You want to join me for
extra
training?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, are you sure? Sorry... I'm sure
you have
other things you need to do.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You really don't hesitate saying cheesy
things like
that...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
M-mental training? What do you mean
by that
exactly?!

I suggest that she add time limits to her
exercises
to be more prepared for the
pressure during
races.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it now. I'm glad it wasn't some
extreme
method.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now that I got the gist of it, I'll
get starte—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What? Why? You just gave me advice
for it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait... You want to join me for
extra
training?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, are you sure? Sorry... I'm sure
you have
other things you need to do.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You really don't hesitate saying cheesy
things like
that...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's get back to training.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, sorry to bother you. You can go
back
now if you want.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, you know... I just figured this
isn't
something other people should
hear.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to ask you about your top
secret
training routine, which I'm sure
you don't want
getting out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I definitely don't want others to
know that
I'm doing this to compete with
Teio.

It seems Nice Nature still isn't confident
enough
to openly compete with such a
strong racer.
